# Visual Reports and Executive Summary Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make the three root-cause reading documents easy on the eye (short paragraphs, bullets, callouts, charts) and add a one-page executive summary that covers the plain-English findings and the recommendations of the two frontier models, reviewed by Opus.

**Architecture:** Charts are generated by one tested script from numbers that are traced to cited source lines, and committed as PNG files next to the reports. The lint gains two scan-ability rules (paragraph length, images need alt text and must exist) so the owner's complaint is enforced, not promised. The findings and the consolidated review are reformatted (same content, new shape), then the executive summary and README route are written on top.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3 and matplotlib 3.10 (already installed), pytest, ruff, Markdown. Continues `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-05-research-readability-and-subfolders.md`.

**Spec:** the owner's message of 2026-11-05: "the reports are still ugly and difficult to look at, can even add visuals and bullet points to help drive the key home, and create an executive summary that encompasses all 3 of these reports and have Opus review the summary". Interpretation (provisional, owner may correct): the three reports are the plain-English findings, the consolidated direction review (which carries both the Opus and the Argon recommendations) and the reference sheet; the executive summary covers findings and recommendations, and links the sheet.

## Global Constraints

Every constraint of the previous plan still applies: frozen bytes (never edit frozen files or the original reports; the reading editions are the only files rewritten), Cyrus voice rules (facts first, a dry line or two per section, none in tables or near NO-GOs, limits or numbers, no em dash and no semicolon outside code spans), names not numbers for checks and rounds, numbers copied from sources never computed (a figure may only plot numbers that appear in the sources), no retirement/IRA/paid-data/live-trader/cache-write/re-run advice, no recommendations of the documents' own, NO-GO never softened, Co-Authored-By trailers, specific paths staged, push only on the owner's word (merge locally at the end), `scripts/run_tests.sh` for tests, ruff clean. Models: Sonnet or Haiku implement, Opus reviews every task (images are read with the Read tool) and does one final whole-branch review. New: emoji only as status markers in tables and callouts (for example a check mark or a warning sign), at most one per row or callout; every image has alt text and a caption line stating the source; charts have their own light background so they read in dark and light viewers; no chart junk, one message per chart, colour never the only signal.

## Review Focus

1. A chart that plots a number not in the sources, or with the wrong sign, unit or window (test: every value in the figure script is found at its cited source line).
2. A reformat that changes meaning: a caveat lost when a paragraph becomes bullets, or a NO-GO turned into a headline joke (Opus fidelity review against the previous version and the sources).
3. The executive summary overstating (one-page pressure drops limits) or presenting an unverified Argon item as verified.
4. Paragraphs still too long, images broken or missing alt text (lint rules in Task 2).
5. New files rejected by `verify --stage final` (PNG files and the summary must be in the allow-new list).

### Task 1: Charts from traced numbers

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/root_cause_figures.py`, `tests/scripts/test_root_cause_figures.py`
- Create (generated, committed): `research/audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/figures/gap-vs-measured.png`, `.../figures/verdict-trust.png`, `.../figures/paper-shortfall.png`, `.../figures/options-at-a-glance.png`
- Modify: `scripts/research_reorg.py` (`DEFAULT_ALLOW_NEW`: add `audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/figures/*.png` and `audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md`), `tests/scripts/test_research_reorg.py` (the allow-new test)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `FIGURES: dict[str, FigureSpec]` where `@dataclass(frozen=True) class FigureSpec: name: str; title: str; alt: str; caption: str; points: tuple[Point, ...]` and `@dataclass(frozen=True) class Point: label: str; value: float; source: str` (source = `"<path>:<line>"` repo-relative with the date prefix kept); `render(name: str, out_dir: Path) -> Path`; CLI `root_cause_figures.py [--out DIR] [--only NAME]` (default `--out research/audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/figures`), `--help`.
- Figures (values copied from sources, each point cites its line): (1) `gap-vs-measured`: horizontal bars, pp/yr: the gap 2x needs over 2021-2026 (9.57), 2006-2026 (3.54), 1927-2026 (0.77); best measured: 2x leverage arm +4.15 over 2006-2026; momentum +4.37 over 2021-2026 drawn with its interval -7.07 to +16.05; stock-picking results after 1994 as a band -0.62 to +0.83. (2) `verdict-trust`: one stacked bar of the 72 measured tests: 0 reliable, 11 unreliable, 58 inconclusive, 3 stopped on their own terms, with the 42 status-label rows noted in the caption, not plotted. (3) `paper-shortfall`: the live account's shortfall against SPY at run-time broker value -3.76 pp and at Alpaca end-of-day equity -4.57 pp (totals since 2026-06-24, not yearly rates, said in the title), beside the stated parts of the run-time figure: idle cash about 2.46 pp (estimate) and the MNST split 0.85 pp; no remainder is computed. (4) `options-at-a-glance`: a three-column diagram (Option 1, 2, 3: the question, the cheapest step, the stop gate in 6 to 12 words each, copied from the consolidated review; no numbers except the ones already in that review); its text constants cite the review lines.
- Style: load and follow the `dataviz` skill (invoke it with the Skill tool before writing chart code); light background card, colour-blind-safe palette, direct labels, value labels on bars, font size readable at 900 px width, 1600x900 px at 200 dpi maximum, file size under 250 KB each.

Find each number's source line by grep in the synthesis, the Ceiling check report, the Verdict Trust report, the Paper-versus-Backtest report and the consolidated review; never invent a value.

### Task 2: Scan-ability rules in the lint

**Files:** Modify `scripts/check_reading_edition.py`, `tests/scripts/test_check_reading_edition.py`.

**Interfaces:** `check_file` gains (all default on for files passed through the CLI): rule 7 `long-paragraph`: a prose paragraph (consecutive non-blank lines that are not a heading, list item, table row, blockquote line or code) of more than `MAX_PARAGRAPH_WORDS = 70` words is a problem (list items longer than 60 words are a problem too); rule 8 `image`: every Markdown image `![alt](path)` has non-empty alt text and its path (relative to the file) exists. CLI flag `--max-paragraph-words N` (default 70) and `--no-scan-rules` to switch rules 7 and 8 off for old documents (the sheet is exempt by flag until reformatted).

- [ ] **Step 1:** Failing tests: `test_flags_paragraph_over_limit`, `test_allows_long_table_and_list_of_short_items`, `test_flags_long_list_item`, `test_flags_image_without_alt_text`, `test_flags_missing_image_file`, `test_allows_existing_image_with_alt`, `test_no_scan_rules_flag_disables_rules_7_and_8`.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Implement; all existing tests stay green; ruff clean; `--help` documents the flags.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Run the lint (with `--no-scan-rules` off) over the current findings, consolidated review and README and record how many paragraph problems each has (the reformat tasks must drive them to 0). Commit `feat(scripts): add scan-ability rules to the reading-edition lint`.

### Task 3: Reformat the plain-English findings

**Files:** Modify `research/audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/findings/2026-11-05-findings-plain-english.md`.

**Interfaces:** Content-preserving reformat. Add at the top a callout `> **The short version**` with 4 to 6 bullets; start every section with a one-line `> **Takeaway:**` callout; turn dense paragraphs into bullets (at most 3 lines each); keep tables narrow (cells under 40 words); embed the figures with relative links `![alt](../figures/gap-vs-measured.png)` and a caption line naming the source; use status markers in tables only where they carry meaning. Every number, caveat, NO-GO, limit and owner decision of the current version stays (compare against `git show HEAD:<path>`). Word cap `--max-words 3200`.

### Task 5: Executive summary, README route, index

**Files:** Create `research/audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/2026-11-05-executive-summary.md`; modify `research/audits/root-cause-2026-11-04/README.md`, `research/RESEARCH_INDEX.md` (root-cause rows), `research/README.md` (one sentence), `docs/changelog.md` (one bullet), the verification record (a short section).

**Interfaces:** The executive summary is one page: about 450 to 700 words, `--max-words 800`. Structure: `> **Bottom line**` callout (3 bullets: the question, the answer, what to decide); `## What we found` (5 to 7 bullets with the numbers that matter, the `gap-vs-measured` figure); `## Why the target was missed` (the six causes, one line each, ranked by judgement, no share measured); `## What the two models recommend` (Opus in 3 bullets, Argon in 3 bullets marked unverified with what survived, where they agree and differ in 2 bullets; the three options in one line each; the `options-at-a-glance` figure); `## What you decide` (the three to five decisions that matter most with their defaults, pointing at the full list of 13); `## What this cannot tell you` (3 to 4 limits); `## Read next` (links to the findings, the consolidated review and the sheet). Every statement traces to the findings, the consolidated review or the sheets they cite; Argon-only items never presented as verified; no recommendations of its own.

- [ ] **Step 1:** Write it (Cyrus voice, defined terms by sheet name, lint exit 0 with the sheet and all sources, paths-only exit 0). **Step 2:** README: the reading route starts with the executive summary, then the findings, the consolidated review, the sheet; index and research README updated; changelog bullet; verification record gets the gate results. **Step 3:** `verify --stage final` with the seven `--require-new` paths (the six plus the summary) exit 0; full suite; ruff. **Step 4:** Commit `docs(research): add executive summary and update the reading route`. Opus review: fidelity of EVERY claim against the two reading documents and the originals (numbers, signs, windows, caveats), that nothing is overstated for the sake of brevity, that Argon is labelled, that it reads well in one pass for an engineer. This is the review the owner asked for.
